summary: Frontend-only regression of consolidated Dashboard (Hero + Goal panel, KPI strip, Chart+Segments, Account detail). All required data-testid selectors present with correct values; segment switching updates figures; expand/search/empty-state work; chart & segments card heights match exactly (diff 0px). Screenshots captured at 1920x1080 and 1280x900 — layout clean, no clipping/overlap. Zero page errors. Only warnings observed are recharts benign 'width(-1) height(-1)' during initial mount (transient, fixed after layout).
critical_code_review_comments: Recharts logs 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings during initial mount for ResponsiveContainer parents that are briefly zero-sized (hero mini-chart, main chart). Non-blocking but noisy — consider giving rv-hero-chart / rv-chart explicit min-height or aspect prop to silence.
rv-invoiced-delta text renders as '14.7% vs LY' with a down-arrow icon when delta is negative; sign is only conveyed via icon + class. Consider prefixing with '−' for a11y/screen readers.
